Team — forwarding FinWave's SIG (attached) with the request below. Procurement wants a first-pass owner roster by EOD 11/16; final returns due 11/29.

I want a pragmatic first pass: three stewardship lanes per section — Primary (who writes + pulls evidence), Secondary (backup reviewer), Evidence Escrow (who collects artifacts and links to index). We don't need full answers yet, just owner names and blockers.

Please reply inline to this thread with: 1) Sections you accept as Primary, 2) any sections you recommend routing to Engineering/Infra/legal (call out why), 3) required artifacts we don't already have (e.g., SOC 2 report, KMS attestation, log retention screenshots).

I'll collate into owner_allocation.csv and upload to the FinWave drive link once we have confirmations. If you can't take a section by EOD tomorrow, mark it as UNASSIGNED so I can escalate.

Initial split suggestion (feel free to adjust):
- Marissa: Data protection / Access control / Incident mgmt sections (sections 1.1 - 1.6)
- Ben: Network & infra controls, encryption at rest/in transit (sections 2.1 - 2.5)
- Aditya: Application security, CI/CD, deployment hardening (sections 3.1 - 3.4)
- Soojin: Vendor mgmt, compliance posture, privacy (sections 4.1 - 4.3)

I have attached a starter evidence index (redwood_evidence_index.xlsx) with the artifacts we already maintain that likely map to common SIG asks. Use that as your baseline and flag gaps.

Attachments: FinWave_SIG_202611.pdf; redwood_evidence_index.xlsx

Thanks — appreciate quick confirmations.
